tasks.label: Setup: Sync dependencies
tasks.detail: Create .venv with Python 3.14 and install locked development/validation dependencies. Preserve installed optional extras.

tasks.label: Setup: Sync dependencies with optional integrations
tasks.detail: Also install optional App Configuration and telemetry dependencies; does not configure or contact Azure services.

tasks.label: Setup: Check Python environment
tasks.detail: Run the Rich import/interpreter preflight without loading Azure settings.

tasks.label: Agents: Smoke test all local agents
tasks.detail: Requires all three local hosts already running. Sends real model requests sequentially and records Rich/JSONL results; can incur token charges. No deployment, grants, or automatic retries.

tasks.label: Agents: Preview hosted deployment (unsupported)
tasks.detail: Currently unsupported/skipped for hosted agents by azd. A successful exit is not a deployment plan or verification. No image build or deployment.

tasks.label: Agents: Deploy all hosted agents
tasks.detail: Explicit paid operation: remote ACR builds and immutable hosted agent versions. Existing foundation/model are reused.

tasks.label: Access: Preview hosted agent permissions
tasks.detail: Shows deployed agent model grants, Data Analysis's Monitoring Metrics Publisher, and the project identity's Monitoring Reader on Application Insights. Does not modify roles.

tasks.label: Access: Preview isolated user Consumer grants
tasks.detail: Read-only plan for the selected test users' project-scoped Foundry Agent Consumer grants. Reuses covering grants. No role writes, sign-in, profile creation, deployment, or agent calls. Does not certify absence of other permissions.

tasks.label: Access: Create isolated user auth profiles
tasks.detail: Choose optional project-scoped Foundry Agent Consumer grants under the operator CLI identity, then isolated Microsoft sign-in. No Foundry User/Owner/impersonation grants or agent calls. Passwords/MFA remain in Microsoft's UI.

tasks.label: Access: Apply hosted agent permissions
tasks.detail: Applies scoped model grants, Monitoring Metrics Publisher for Data Analysis, and Monitoring Reader for the project identity on Application Insights. Reuses existing grants; no developer, Blob, or impersonation grants.

tasks.label: Agents: Smoke test all hosted agents
tasks.detail: Three real remote inference requests, one per active hosted agent, using the Azure CLI user. Can incur model/session usage. Not localhost.

tasks.label: Agents: Deploy and smoke test all hosted agents
dependsOn: Agents: Smoke test all hosted agents
tasks.detail: Explicit paid agent deployment, scoped agent RBAC, then independent hosted smoke. Does not verify delegation, isolation or recovery, or reprovision the foundation.

tasks.label: Access: Preview Supervisor impersonation permission
tasks.detail: Read-only plan: the standard hosted model/telemetry and project Insights roles, plus the Supervisor's single custom impersonation action at the selected project. Does not modify roles.

tasks.label: Access: Apply Supervisor impersonation permission
tasks.detail: Applies the standard hosted model/telemetry and project Insights roles, plus the explicit project-scoped impersonation role for Supervisor only. Does not establish working delegation. No Blob grants.

tasks.label: Agents: Diagnose hosted caller context
tasks.detail: Direct Research versus one Supervisor-to-Research presence-only probe. No model inference, workflow-state writes, grants or deployments. Missing context is reported as FAIL.

tasks.label: Agents: Test hosted identity variants and isolation
tasks.detail: Explicit opt-in hosted diagnostics: separate call-context/user-label variants, one-hour synthetic state markers and A-A-B history checks. No model calls or role changes; hosting usage applies. Genuine two-Entra-user tests remain blocked.

tasks.label: Agents: Test native Entra user isolation
tasks.detail: Verbose Rich request/response panels for real native-user Research state/history tests. Sanitized diagnostic replies, HTTP status/trace metadata, and unchanged isolation assertions. No models, grants, deployment, login, or retries.

tasks.label: Agents: Test hosted workflow state and delegation
tasks.detail: Currently blocked by missing verified specialist caller context. Paid synthetic hosted create/inspect/replay/continue, separate specialist histories and unknown-workflow rejection. No crash or OOM injection.

tasks.label: Agents: Deploy and test hosted delegation
dependsOn: Agents: Smoke test all hosted agents
Agents: Test hosted workflow state and delegation
tasks.detail: Currently blocked by missing verified specialist caller context. Explicit paid deployment, model permissions, independent smoke and workflow test; no foundation reprovisioning. Fails closed rather than bypassing isolation.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 1 - 1 Enable Code Interpreter on existing Data Analysis agent
tasks.detail: Native-only readiness on the existing Data Analysis agent. Preview is local; run creates one bound session and one paid analysis, validates original outputs, and saves a separate native baseline. Never deploys, grants roles, creates an agent, or creates a toolbox.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 1 - 2 Analyze data and deliver outputs
tasks.detail: Native model-written analysis of seeded 1k-row CSV; independently checks rows/cells/totals and downloads original CSV/PNG session files. Preview is local; run makes one paid analysis. Chart meaning requires an offline hash-bound human review, not another inference. Requires native Step 1.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 1 - 3 Evaluate dataset sizes
tasks.detail: Native finite capacity ladder: baseline 1k/10k/100k or explicitly enabled pressure 250k/500k/1M rows. One analysis per size, no retries, stop at first failure/unavailable memory metric or 75% of observed interpreter limit. Preview is local; run is paid. No toolbox mutations.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 1 - 4 Assess sandbox boundaries
tasks.detail: Native application isolation with two real existing user profiles: own analysis/original downloads, foreign workflow/session-file denial, and clean-session ownership checks. Preview is local; run makes two paid analyses. No login, role changes, native-file confidentiality claim, or container deletion.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 1 - 5 Assess state continuity
tasks.detail: Native runner-driven Blob checkpoint write/readback and reconstruction in a fresh bound session (two paid analyses). Optional Hosted idle observation is bounded best effort. Preview is local; run uses authenticated public storage. Never silently substitutes local checkpoint bytes, deletes evidence, or redesigns on failure.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 1 Demonstrate Supervisor delegation
tasks.detail: AC1. verify = no changes. prepare-if-missing = once, create the Research MCP toolbox story4-research-mcp, set RESEARCH_TOOLBOX_ENDPOINT, and azd deploy --all (same agents and identities). Paid: two model-routed Supervisor delegations (Research, Data Analysis). Writes a report under step-01-supervisor-delegation\ and the Story 4 baseline.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 2 Assess sync and async delegation
tasks.detail: AC2. Read-only reuse of the Story 4 baseline. Paid: Supervisor -> Research synchronous and background delegation, each with a simulated sub-agent failure, plus one direct background request to Research and one client background POC_DELEGATE that the Supervisor must reject. No retries. Writes a report under step-02-sync-async-and-failure\.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 3 Demonstrate Research tool call
tasks.detail: AC3. Read-only reuse of the Story 4 baseline. Direct toolbox MCP probe plus one paid Supervisor -> Research request that calls the Microsoft Learn MCP search tool. Writes a report under step-03-research-tool-call\ with the trust-boundary table.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 4 Evaluate identity paths
tasks.detail: AC4. Read-only reuse of the Story 4 baseline; reads (never grants) the Supervisor's impersonation permission. Paid: Supervisor -> Research in agent-owned, call-context, and delegated-user modes, plus agent-owned Research -> toolbox. Writes a report under step-04-identity-paths\.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 5 Trace identity and access
tasks.detail: AC5. Read-only reuse of the Story 4 baseline; reads role assignments only. Paid: one traced client -> Supervisor -> Research -> tool request, then platform (impersonation, toolbox allowed_tools) and application (allow-list) denials. Writes a report under step-05-trace-and-access\.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 6 Demonstrate Data Analysis via Supervisor
tasks.detail: AC6. Native stateless Supervisor compatibility probe using the existing agents and reviewed native Story 1 evidence. Preview is local; run is a bounded best-effort attempt, not a workflow redesign. A missing trusted native contract is reported as blocked, with redesign proposed only for your approval.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 7 Invoke Research directly
tasks.detail: AC7. Read-only reuse of the Story 4 baseline. Creates one conversation per agent, then two paid requests only to Research in its own conversation (no Supervisor). Writes a report under step-07-direct-invocation\.

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Preview changes (Azure CLI)
tasks.detail: Read-only native what-if. Uses the checked-in North Central US preview inputs; does not provision or grant permissions.

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Preview changes (azd)
tasks.detail: Requires an initialized azd environment; the preprovision hook validates the subscription, environment name, and region.

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Apply changes (azd)
tasks.detail: MUTATES AZURE and can incur charges. Run only after reviewing the native what-if. Does not invoke developer RBAC grants.

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Inspect deployment operations
tasks.detail: Inspect operations after deployment. Inspect nested operations with az deployment operation group list.

tasks.label: Setup: Create .env from deployment
tasks.detail: Discovers the latest successful deployment for the selected environment. Creates .env without overwriting an existing file.

tasks.label: Setup: Update .env from deployment
tasks.detail: Refreshes only project endpoint, model deployment, and optional App Configuration endpoint. Preserves all other local values.

tasks.label: Access: Preview developer permissions
tasks.detail: Separate from deployment; reads outputs from the deployed foundation and previews missing scoped roles.

tasks.label: Access: Apply developer permissions
tasks.detail: Explicitly grants displayed missing roles, then verifies synthetic Blob/monitoring access. Never runs as a provisioning/debug hook.

inputs.description: preview = local operation summary only; run = execute the separately approved paid native validation budget (no deployment/grants/deletion)
baseline = original 1k/10k/100k cases; pressure = separately approved 250k/500k/1M ladder, also requiring backend pressure enablement
skip = no optional Hosted idle probe; observe = one bounded no-request interval and marker check, never force-stop/delete. Redesign requires approval.
verify = no changes; prepare-if-missing = create the Story 4 Research MCP toolbox and azd deploy --all the EXISTING agents once if not already done

options.label: Verbose - request/response panels and full details
Not verbose - request labels and assertion summaries

inputs.description: RBAC: consumer = grant only Foundry Agent Consumer on the selected project before sign-in; none = authentication only. Run from your operator/admin CLI context.
Comma-separated full user sign-in names, e.g. user1@tenant.onmicrosoft.com,user2@tenant.onmicrosoft.com. Never enter passwords.
Explicit Azure subscription name or ID
Exact timestamped subscription deployment name for operation inspection (az deployment sub list)
Environment whose latest successful deployment will be discovered
Local identity to grant (azd must match the az CLI user)
